pure_v1_verdict.basis: PURE_PLAYER_V1 reads only box-score counts, snap counts, the player crosswalk and allowlisted schedule columns; it reads no play-by-play, so no nflfastR model output (vegas_wp, xpass, pass_oe, PROE, team ratings) can reach it; its EWMA constants were selected by sports-only MAE; runtime mutation tests prove bit-identical forecasts with the market columns removed or randomised.
caveats: target-game starting QB id from the schedule defines the QB-passing population (hindsight, not market)
the V1 study's DATA_ONLY_GAME comparison arm is indirectly market-informed through PROE: the PURE-vs-DATA_ONLY points comparison is PURE vs an indirectly market-informed arm

v4_verdict.even_with_market_env_false: training sample gated on a closing line existing (volume.py:74), and injury/roster statuses that are not PIT for 2025
